title.en: Unit 4: Holy Cities, the Elephant Story and the King Najashi
title.ur: Unit 4: Muqaddas shehar, Ashab-ul-Feel aur Najashi badshah

intro.en: A reading text about Makkah, Madinah and Al-Quds (Jerusalem) and the three mosques the Prophet ﷺ named. Read slowly, sentence by sentence. In the exercises you also practise broken plurals (e.g. قَلْب → قُلوب).
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein Makkah, Madinah aur Al-Quds (Baitul Maqdis) ke baare mein parhne ka matn hai, aur un teen masjidon ka zikr jin ka naam Nabi ﷺ ne liya. Aahista aahista jumla ba jumla parhein. Mashqon mein jam-e-taksir bhi seekhenge (jaise قَلْب → قُلوب).
intro.ar: نَصٌّ عَنْ مَكَّةَ وَالمَدينَةِ وَالقُدْسِ وَالمَساجِدِ الثَّلاثَةِ الَّتي ذَكَرَها النَّبِيُّ ﷺ. اقْرَأْهُ بِبُطْءٍ جُمْلَةً جُمْلَةً، ثُمَّ تَتَدَرَّبُ عَلى جَمْعِ التَّكْسيرِ مِثْلَ قَلْب وَجَمْعُهُ قُلوب.

dialogue.ar: قالَ الرَّسولُ ﷺ: «لا تُشَدُّ الرِّحالُ إِلا إِلى ثَلاثَةِ مَساجِدَ: المَسْجِدِ الحَرامِ، وَمَسْجِدي هَذا، وَالمَسْجِدِ الأَقْصى».
dialogue.tr: qāla r-rasūlu ﷺ: «lā tushaddu r-riḥālu ilā ilā thalāthati masājid: al-masjidi l-ḥarām, wa masjidī hadhā, wa l-masjidi l-aqṣā.»
dialogue.en: The Messenger ﷺ said: travel is not undertaken except to three mosques: the Sacred Mosque, this mosque of mine, and Al-Aqsa Mosque.
dialogue.ur: Rasool ﷺ ne farmaya: safar ka iraada sirf teen masjidon ke liye kiya jaye: Masjid-e-Haram, meri yeh masjid aur Masjid-e-Aqsa.

dialogue.ar: تَتَعَلَّقُ قُلوبُ المُسْلِمينَ في كُلِّ العُصورِ بِثَلاثِ مُدُنٍ مُقَدَّسَةٍ، لِكُلٍّ مِنْها مَعالِمُ وَمَكانَةٌ خاصَّة.
dialogue.tr: tataʿallaqu qulūbu l-muslimīna fī kulli l-ʿuṣūri bi-thalāthi mudunin muqaddasat, likullin minhā maʿālimu wa makānatun khāṣṣa.
dialogue.en: In every age the hearts of Muslims are attached to three holy cities, each with its own landmarks and special standing.
dialogue.ur: Har daur mein musalmanon ke dil teen muqaddas shehron se jure rehte hain, har ek ke apne nishanat aur khaas maqam hai.

dialogue.ar: أُولاها مَكَّةُ المُكَرَّمَةُ، وَهِيَ مَسْقَطُ رَأْسِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ، وَفيها بَدَأَ نُزولُ الوَحْي.
dialogue.tr: uūlāhā makkatu l-mukarramat, wa hiya masqaṭu raʾsi n-nabiyyi ﷺ, wa fīhā badaʾa nuzūlu l-waḥī.
dialogue.en: The first is honoured Makkah, the birthplace of the Prophet ﷺ, and in it the revelation began to come down.
dialogue.ur: Pehla Makkah Mukarramah hai, jo Nabi ﷺ ki jaay-e-paidaish hai, aur us mein wahi nazil hona shuru hui.

dialogue.ar: وَفي وَسَطِها الكَعْبَةُ المُشَرَّفَةُ، وَإِلَيْها يَتَوَجَّهُ المُسْلِمونَ في صَلاتِهِمْ؛ فَهِيَ قِبْلَتُهُم.
dialogue.tr: wa fī wa saṭihā l-kaʿbatu l-musharrafat, wa ilayhā yatawajjahu l-muslimūna fī ṣalātihim; fa-hiya qiblatuhum.
dialogue.en: In its middle stands the honoured Kaaba, towards which Muslims turn in their prayer; it is their qibla.
dialogue.ur: Us ke beech mein Kaaba Musharrafah hai, jis ki taraf musalman namaz mein rukh karte hain; wahi un ka qibla hai.

dialogue.ar: وَقَدْ رَفَعَ قَواعِدَ الكَعْبَةِ إِبْراهيمُ وَابْنُهُ إِسْماعيلُ عَلَيْهِما السَّلام.
dialogue.tr: wa qad rafaʿa qawāʿida l-kaʿbati ibrāhīmu wa bnuhu ismāʿīlu ʿalayhimā s-salām.
dialogue.en: Ibrahim and his son Ismail, peace be upon them, raised the foundations of the Kaaba.
dialogue.ur: Kaaba ki bunyadein Ibrahim aur un ke bete Ismail alaihimas salam ne uthayin.

dialogue.ar: وَيَأْتي الحُجّاجُ مِنْ كُلِّ بَلَدٍ لِأَداءِ الحَجِّ، فَيَزورونَ المَشاعِرَ المُقَدَّسَةَ وَيَقِفونَ في عَرَفات.
dialogue.tr: wa yaʾtī l-ḥujjāju min kulli baladin li-adāʾi l-ḥajj, fa-yazūrūna l-mashāʿira l-muqaddasata wa yaqifūna fī ʿarafāt.
dialogue.en: Pilgrims come from every country to perform Hajj; they visit the holy sites and stand at Arafat.
dialogue.ur: Hajji har mulk se hajj ada karne aate hain, muqaddas muqamat ki ziyarat karte hain aur Arafat mein qayam karte hain.

dialogue.ar: وَالمَدينَةُ المُنَوَّرَةُ هِيَ الثّانِيَةُ؛ إِلَيْها هاجَرَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ، وَفيها المَسْجِدُ النَّبَوِيّ.
dialogue.tr: wa l-madīnatu l-munawwaratu hiya th-thāniyat; ilayhā hājara n-nabiyyu ﷺ, wa fīhā l-masjidu n-nabawiyy.
dialogue.en: Illuminated Madinah is the second; the Prophet ﷺ migrated to it, and the Prophet's Mosque is in it.
dialogue.ur: Madinah Munawwarah doosra hai; Nabi ﷺ ne us ki taraf hijrat ki, aur us mein Masjid-e-Nabawi hai.

dialogue.ar: وَمِنْ مَعالِمِ المَدينَةِ قُباءٌ؛ فَفيها مَسْجِدٌ بُنِيَ عَلَى التَّقْوى، وَقَريباً مِنْها يَقومُ جَبَلُ أُحُد.
dialogue.tr: wa min maʿālimi l-madīnati qubāʾ; fa-fīhā masjidun buniya ʿalā t-taqūā, wa qarībn minhā yaqūmu jabalu uḥud.
dialogue.en: Among Madinah's landmarks is Quba: in it is a mosque built on piety, and near it stands Mount Uhud.
dialogue.ur: Madinah ke nishanat mein Quba hai: us mein taqwa par bani hui masjid hai, aur us ke qareeb Uhud ka pahaad hai.

dialogue.ar: وَالقُدْسُ هِيَ المَدينَةُ الثّالِثَةُ، وَفيها المَسْجِدُ الأَقْصى الَّذي كانَ قِبْلَةَ المُسْلِمينَ الأولى.
dialogue.tr: wa l-qudsu hiya l-madīnatu th-thālithat, wa fīhā l-masjidu l-aqṣā l-dhī kāna qiblata l-muslimīna l-ʾūlā.
dialogue.en: Al-Quds is the third city, and in it is Al-Aqsa Mosque, which was the Muslims' first qibla.
dialogue.ur: Quds teesra shehar hai, aur us mein Masjid-e-Aqsa hai jo musalmanon ka pehla qibla tha.

dialogue.ar: وَالقُدْسُ عاصِمَةُ فِلَسْطينَ، وَيَدْعو المُسْلِمونَ اللهَ أَنْ يَحْفَظَها وَأَهْلَها.
dialogue.tr: wa l-qudsu ʿāṣimatu filasṭīn, wa yadʿū l-muslimūna llāha an yaḥfaẓahā wa ahlahā.
dialogue.en: Al-Quds is the capital of Palestine, and Muslims ask Allah to protect it and its people.
dialogue.ur: Quds Filastin ka daar-ul-hukumat hai, aur musalman Allah se dua karte hain ke woh us ki aur us ke baasiyon ki hifazat farmaye.

dialogue.ar: فَهٰذِهِ المُدُنُ تَحْمِلُ ذِكْرَياتٍ عَظيمَةً مِنْ تاريخِ الإِسْلامِ، وَتَبْقى مَعالِمُها شاهِدَةً عَلى تِلْكَ العُصور.
dialogue.tr: fa-hādhihi l-mudunu taḥmilu dhikrayātin ʿaẓīmatan min tārīkhi l-islām, wa tabqā maʿālimuhā shāhidatan ʿalā tilka l-ʿuṣūr.
dialogue.en: These cities carry great memories from the history of Islam, and their landmarks remain witness to those ages.
dialogue.ur: Yeh shehar Islam ki tareekh ki azeem yaadein rakhte hain, aur un ke nishanat un daurson ke gawah rehte hain.

dialogue.ar: وَمَنْ زارَها لِلْحَجِّ أَوْ لِلصَّلاةِ عادَ وَقَلْبُهُ مُعَلَّقٌ بِها شَوْقاً إِلى العَوْدَة.
dialogue.tr: wa man zārahā li-l-ḥajji aw li-ṣ-ṣalāti ʿāda wa qalbuhu muʿallaqun bihā shawqn ilā l-ʿawda.
dialogue.en: Whoever visits them for Hajj or for prayer returns with his heart hanging on them, longing to come back.
dialogue.ur: Jo hajj ya namaz ke liye wahan jaye woh lautta hai to us ka dil wahin atka rehta hai aur dobara jaane ka shauq rehta hai.

q.en: Which is the third holy city for Muslims, according to the text?
q.ur: Matn ke mutabiq musalmanon ka teesra muqaddas shehar kaun sa hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ مَدينَةٍ هِيَ الثّالِثَةُ المُقَدَّسَةُ عِنْدَ المُسْلِمينَ بِحَسَبِ النَّصِّ؟

q.en: Who built the Kaaba, according to the text?
q.ur: Matn ke mutabiq Kaaba kis ne banaya?

q.en: Which mosque in Madinah, according to the text, was built on piety?
q.ur: Matn ke mutabiq Madinah ki kaun si masjid taqwa par bani?
q.ar: أَيُّ مَسْجِدٍ في المَدينَةِ بُنِيَ عَلَى التَّقْوى، بِحَسَبِ النَّصِّ؟

options: The Messenger's birthplace / Rasool ki jaay-e-paidaish
The Messenger's mosque / Rasool ki masjid
The Messenger's journey / Rasool ka safar
The Messenger's book / Rasool ki kitab

title.en: Grammar: Making the verb feminine for the doer
title.ur: Qawaid: Fa'il ke liye fe'l ko muannas karna

intro.en: When the doer (الفاعِل) is a feminine noun, the verb takes a feminine ending: قالَتْ (she said). Sometimes it is a must (واجِب), sometimes it is allowed (جائِز). Example: قالَتِ امْرَأَةُ العَزيزِ (the Aziz's wife said) – the verb is feminine because the doer is a real woman right next to it. When a word separates verb and doer, the feminine ending becomes optional.
intro.ur: Jab fa'il (kaam karne wala) muannas ho to fe'l ke saath muannas ki alamat lagti hai: قالَتْ (us ne kaha). Kabhi yeh wajib (واجِب) hota hai aur kabhi jaiz (جائِز). Misal: قالَتِ امْرَأَةُ العَزيزِ – fe'l muannas hai kyunke fa'il haqiqi aurat hai aur fe'l ke bilkul saath hai. Agar fe'l aur fa'il ke darmiyan koi lafz aa jaye to tanees jaiz ho jati hai.
intro.ar: إِذا كانَ الفاعِلُ اسْماً مُؤَنَّثاً لَحِقَتِ الفِعْلَ عَلامَةُ التَّأْنيثِ مِثْلَ «قالَتْ». وَيَكونُ ذٰلِكَ أَحْياناً واجِباً وَأَحْياناً جائِزاً. مِثالٌ: «قالَتِ امْرَأَةُ العَزيزِ» وَجَبَ التَّأْنيثُ لِأَنَّ الفاعِلَ امْرَأَةٌ حَقيقِيَّةٌ مُتَّصِلَةٌ بِالفِعْلِ. وَإِذا فُصِلَ بَيْنَ الفِعْلِ وَالفاعِلِ جازَ التَّأْنيثُ وَتَرْكُهُ.

q.en: Which sentence has a feminine verb for the doer?
q.ur: Kis jumle mein fa'il ke liye fe'l muannas hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ جُمْلَةٍ فيها فِعْلٌ مُؤَنَّثٌ لِفاعِلٍ مُؤَنَّثٍ؟

q.en: In «قالَتِ امْرَأَةُ العَزيزِ» the feminine ending on the verb is…
q.ur: «قالَتِ امْرَأَةُ العَزيزِ» mein fe'l par muannas ki alamat…

q.en: Which word means "the doer" in grammar?
q.ur: Nahw mein "kaam karne wala" ke liye kaun sa lafz hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني مَنْ يَقومُ بِالفِعْلِ في النَّحْوِ؟

title.en: Listening: The People of the Elephant and Two Counsels
title.ur: Sunna aur samajhna: Ashab-ul-Feel aur do wasiyatein

intro.en: Two listening texts. In the first, about Abrahah and the People of the Elephant, you listen and mark each sentence true or false. In the second, two counsels are given about justice and war. Press the audio on the slides, then answer the true/false statements.
intro.ur: Sunne ke do matn. Pehle mein Abrahah aur Ashab-ul-Feel ka waqia hai; sun kar har jumle par sahi ya ghalat ka nishan lagayein. Doosre mein insaf aur jang ke baare mein do wasiyatein hain. Slides ki audio sunein phir jawab dein.
intro.ar: نَصّانِ لِلِاسْتِماعِ. في الأَوَّلِ قِصَّةُ أَبْرَهَةَ وَأَصْحابِ الفيلِ، تَسْتَمِعُ ثُمَّ تُحَدِّدُ صَوابَ كُلِّ جُمْلَةٍ أَوْ خَطَأَها. وَفي الثّاني وَصِيَّتانِ في العَدْلِ وَالحَرْبِ. اِضْغَطْ عَلى الصَّوْتِ في الشَّرائِحِ ثُمَّ أَجِبْ.

q.ur: "Qazi / jaj (jama)" ke liye kaun sa lafz hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني «مَنْ يَحْكُمونَ بَيْنَ النّاسِ»؟

intro.en: Speaking practice: discuss with your classmate the topics on the page about marriage and family (early or late marriage, marrying a relative or a stranger, many children or few). Prepare points and examples first, then talk.
intro.ur: Bolne ki mashq: apne sathi ke saath shaadi aur khandan ke mauzoat par guftagu karein (jaldi ya der se shaadi, rishtedar mein ya ghair mein, zyada ya kam bachay). Pehle apne nukaat aur misalein tayyar karein phir baat karein.
intro.ar: تَدْريبٌ عَلى الكَلامِ: تُناقِشُ مَعَ زَميلِكَ المَوْضوعاتِ المَكْتوبَةَ في الصَّفْحَةِ عَنِ الزَّواجِ وَالأُسْرَةِ (الزَّواجُ المُبَكِّرُ أَوِ المُتَأَخِّرُ، الزَّواجُ مِنَ القَريبَةِ أَوِ الغَريبَةِ، كَثْرَةُ الأَوْلادِ أَوْ قِلَّتُهُمْ). حَضِّرِ الأَفْكارَ وَالأَمْثِلَةَ أَوَّلاً ثُمَّ تَكَلَّمْ.

options_ar: عَقْدٌ يَجْمَعُ بَيْنَ الرَّجُلِ وَالمَرْأَةِ لِتَكْوينِ أُسْرَةٍ

title.ur: Qawaid: Maf'ool bihi ko pehle lana

intro.en: Usually the order is verb, doer, then object: فَهِمْتُ الدَّرْسَ (I understood the lesson). Sometimes the object comes first. This is required (واجِب) in some cases, e.g. when the object is a question word like فَأَيَّ آياتِ اللهِ, and impossible (مُمْتَنِع) in others. Example from the Quran: وَإِذِ ابْتَلى إِبْراهيمَ رَبُّهُ – Ibrahim (object) comes before his Lord (doer).
intro.ur: Aam tarteeb yeh hai: fe'l, fa'il, phir maf'ool: فَهِمْتُ الدَّرْسَ (maine sabaq samjha). Kabhi maf'ool pehle aata hai. Kuch surton mein yeh wajib (واجِب) hota hai, jaise sawali lafz فَأَيَّ آياتِ اللهِ, aur kuch mein mumtani' (مُمْتَنِع, nahin ho sakta). Quran ki misal: وَإِذِ ابْتَلى إِبْراهيمَ رَبُّهُ – Ibrahim (maf'ool) apne Rabb (fa'il) se pehle aaya.
intro.ar: التَّرْتيبُ المُعْتادُ في الجُمْلَةِ: فِعْلٌ ثُمَّ فاعِلٌ ثُمَّ مَفْعولٌ بِهِ، مِثْلَ «فَهِمْتُ الدَّرْسَ». وَقَدْ يَتَقَدَّمُ المَفْعولُ بِهِ؛ وَيَجِبُ ذٰلِكَ في مَواضِعَ مِنْها أَنْ يَكونَ اسْمَ اسْتِفْهامٍ مِثْلَ «فَأَيَّ آياتِ اللهِ»، وَيَمْتَنِعُ في مَواضِعَ أُخْرى. مِثالٌ قُرْآنِيٌّ: «وَإِذِ ابْتَلى إِبْراهيمَ رَبُّهُ» تَقَدَّمَ المَفْعولُ (إِبْراهيمَ) عَلى الفاعِلِ (رَبُّهُ).

vocab.en: the object (what the action falls on)

q.en: In «فَهِمْتُ الدَّرْسَ», which word is the object?
q.ur: «فَهِمْتُ الدَّرْسَ» mein maf'ool kaun sa lafz hai?
q.ar: في «فَهِمْتُ الدَّرْسَ»، أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ هِيَ المَفْعولُ بِهِ؟

q.en: What does «مُمْتَنِع» mean in these exercises?

options_ar: الكَلِمَةُ الَّتي تَدُلُّ عَلى الحَدَثِ وَالزَّمَنِ

title.en: Extended reading: Najashi and his guests
title.ur: Wasee parhna: Najashi aur uske mehman

intro.en: A longer story about the Muslims who migrated to Abyssinia (al-Habasha), the king Najashi, the two men sent by Quraysh with gifts, and Jafar ibn Abi Talib's speech about Islam. Read it in parts, then do the exercises (true/false, matching, order the events).
intro.ur: Habsha hijrat karne wale musalmanon, badshah Najashi, Quraish ke bheje hue do aadmiyon aur Jafar bin Abi Talib ki Islam ke baare mein taqreer ki lambi kahani. Hisson mein parhein phir mashqein (sahi/ghalat, milana, waqiat ki tarteeb) karein.
intro.ar: قِصَّةٌ أَطْوَلُ عَنِ المُسْلِمينَ الَّذينَ هاجَروا إِلى الحَبَشَةِ، وَمَلِكِهِمُ النَّجاشِيِّ، وَرَجُلَيْنِ أَرْسَلَتْهُما قُرَيْشٌ بِهَدايا، وَكَلامِ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ أَبي طالِبٍ عَنِ الإِسْلامِ. اقْرَأْها عَلى أَجْزاءٍ ثُمَّ أَجِبْ عَنْ تَمارينِ الصَّوابِ وَالخَطَأِ وَالمُطابَقَةِ وَتَرْتيبِ الأَحْداثِ.

dialogue.ar: ضاقَتْ قُرَيْشٌ ذَرْعاً حينَ عَلِمَتْ أَنَّ المُسْلِمينَ المُهاجِرينَ يَعيشونَ آمِنينَ في أَرْضِ الحَبَشَة.
dialogue.tr: ḍāqat qurayshun dharʿn ḥīna ʿalimat anna l-muslimīna l-muhājirīna yaʿīshūna ʾāminīna fī arḍi l-ḥabasha.
dialogue.en: Quraysh was distressed when it learned that the migrant Muslims were living in safety in the land of Abyssinia.
dialogue.ur: Quraish tang aa gaye jab unhein pata chala ke muhajir musalman Habsha ki sar-zameen mein aman se reh rahe hain.

dialogue.ar: فَقَرَّروا أَنْ يُرْسِلوا إِلى المَلِكِ وَفْداً يَطْلُبُ مِنْهُ تَسْليمَ المُسْلِمين.
dialogue.tr: fa-qarrarū an yursilū ilā l-maliki wa fdn yaṭlubu minhu taslīma l-muslimīn.
dialogue.en: So they decided to send the king a delegation that would ask him to hand over the Muslims.
dialogue.ur: To unhon ne faisla kiya ke badshah ke paas aisa wafd bhejein jo musalmanon ko un ke hawale karne ka mutalba kare.

dialogue.ar: وَاخْتاروا لِلْمُهِمَّةِ عَمْرَو بْنَ العاصِ وَعَبْدَ اللهِ بْنَ أَبي رَبيعَةَ، وَحَمَّلوهُما هَدايا ثَمينَةً لِلْمَلِكِ وَلِكِبارِ رِجالِ دينِه.
dialogue.tr: wa khtārū li-l-muhimmati ʿamraw bna l-ʿāṣi wa ʿabda llāhi bna abī rabīʿat, wa ḥammalūhumā hadāī thamīnatan li-l-maliki wa likibāri rijāli dīnih.
dialogue.en: They chose for the task Abdullah ibn Abi Rabi'a and 'Amr ibn al-'As, and loaded them with valuable gifts for the king and the senior men of his religion.
dialogue.ur: Is kaam ke liye Abdullah bin Abi Rabia aur Amr bin al-As ko chuna, aur badshah aur uske bare mazhabi logon ke liye qeemti tohfe un ke saath kiye.

dialogue.ar: فَلَمّا وَصَلا قَدَّما الهَدايا، ثُمَّ قالا لِلْمَلِكِ إِنَّ هٰؤُلاءِ تَرَكوا دينَ قَوْمِهِمْ وَجاؤوا بِدينٍ جَديد.
dialogue.tr: fa-lammā wa ṣalā qaddamā l-hadāī, thumma qālā li-l-maliki inna hāʾulāʾi tarakū dīna qawmihim wa jāʾū bi-dīnin jadīd.
dialogue.en: When they arrived they presented the gifts, then told the king that these people had left their people's religion and come with a new religion.
dialogue.ur: Jab pohanche to tohfe pesh kiye phir badshah se kaha ke in logon ne apni qaum ka deen chhor diya aur ek naya deen le aaye.

dialogue.ar: فَغَضِبَ النَّجاشِيُّ وَقالَ إِنَّهُ لَنْ يَحْكُمَ عَلَيْهِمْ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَسْمَعَ كَلامَهُم.
dialogue.tr: fa-ghaḍiba n-najāshiyyu wa qāla innahu lan yaḥkuma ʿalayhim qabla an yasmaʿa kalāmahum.
dialogue.en: Najashi became angry and said he would not judge them before hearing their words.
dialogue.ur: Najashi ko ghussa aaya aur kaha ke woh un ki baat sunne se pehle un par koi faisla nahi karega.

dialogue.ar: فَأَرْسَلَ في طَلَبِ المُسْلِمينَ، وَاخْتاروا جَعْفَرَ بْنَ أَبي طالِبٍ لِيَتَكَلَّمَ عَنْهُم.
dialogue.tr: fa-arsala fī ṭalabi l-muslimīn, wa khtārū jaʿfara bna abī ṭālibin li-yatakallama ʿanhum.
dialogue.en: So he sent for the Muslims, and they chose Ja'far ibn Abi Talib to speak on their behalf.
dialogue.ur: Phir us ne musalmanon ko bulaya, aur unhon ne Jafar bin Abi Talib ko apni taraf se bolne ke liye chuna.

dialogue.ar: أَخْبِروني، لِماذا تَرَكْتُمْ دينَ آبائِكُمْ، وَما هٰذِهِ الدَّعْوَةُ الَّتي اتَّبَعْتُموها؟
dialogue.tr: akhbirūnī, li-mādhā taraktum dīna ʾābāʾikum, wa mā hādhihi d-daʿwatu l-tī ttabaʿtumūhā?
dialogue.en: Tell me, why did you leave the religion of your fathers, and what is this call you have followed?
dialogue.ur: Mujhe batayein, aap ne apne baap dada ka deen kyun chhora, aur yeh kaun si dawat hai jis ki aap ne pairwi ki?

dialogue.ar: أَيُّها المَلِكُ، عاشَ قَوْمُنا زَمَناً في الجاهِلِيَّةِ، فَعَبَدوا الأَصْنامَ وَأَكَلوا المَيْتَةَ، وَكانَ القَوِيُّ فيهِمْ يَظْلِمُ الضَّعيف.
dialogue.tr: ayyuhā l-malik, ʿāsha qawmunā zamann fī l-jāhiliyyat, fa-ʿabadū l-aṣnāma wa akalū l-maytat, wa kāna l-qawiyyu fīhim yaẓlimu ḍ-ḍaʿīf.
dialogue.en: O king, our people in the Jahiliyyah worshipped idols and ate carrion, and the strong among them wronged the weak.
dialogue.ur: Ae badshah, hamari qaum jahiliyyat mein butoon ko poojti, murdar khati thi, aur un mein taqatwar kamzor par zulm karta tha.

dialogue.ar: إِلى أَنْ أَرْسَلَ اللهُ فينا رَجُلاً مِنْ أَنْفُسِنا، نَعْرِفُ صِدْقَهُ وَأَمانَتَهُ وَشَرَفَ نَسَبِه.
dialogue.tr: ilā an arsala llāhu fīnā rajuln min anfusinā, naʿrifu ṣidqahu wa amānatahu wa sharafa nasabih.
dialogue.en: Until Allah sent among us a man from ourselves, whose truthfulness, trustworthiness and noble lineage we knew.
dialogue.ur: Yahan tak ke Allah ne hum mein se ek shakhs bheja jis ki sachchai, amanat aur sharif nasab ko hum jaante the.

dialogue.ar: دَعانا إِلى عِبادَةِ اللهِ وَحْدَهُ وَتَرْكِ الأَصْنامِ الَّتي كانَ آباؤُنا يَعْبُدونَها.
dialogue.tr: daʿānā ilā ʿibādati llāhi waḥdahu wa tarki l-aṣnāmi l-tī kāna ʾābāʾunā yaʿbudūnahā.
dialogue.en: He called us to worship Allah alone and to leave the idols our fathers used to worship.
dialogue.ur: Us ne humein sirf Allah ki ibadat aur un butoon ko chhorne ki dawat di jin ki hamare baap dada ibadat karte the.

dialogue.ar: وَعَلَّمَنا الصِّدْقَ وَالأَمانَةَ وَصِلَةَ الرَّحِمِ وَحُسْنَ الجِوارِ، وَنَهانا عَنِ الظُّلْم.
dialogue.tr: wa ʿallamanā ṣ-ṣidqa wa l-amānata wa ṣilata r-raḥimi wa ḥusna l-jiūr, wa nahānā ʿani ẓ-ẓulm.
dialogue.en: He taught us truthfulness, trustworthiness, keeping family ties and good neighbourliness, and forbade us wrongdoing.
dialogue.ur: Us ne humein sach, amanat, silah-rehmi aur achhi padosi sikhayi, aur zulm se mana kiya.

dialogue.ar: وَعَلَّمَنا أَداءَ الصَّلاةِ وَإِخْراجَ الزَّكاةِ وَصِيامَ رَمَضانَ، فَآمَنّا بِما جاءَ بِهِ.
dialogue.tr: wa ʿallamanā adāʾa ṣ-ṣalāti wa ikhrāja z-zakāti wa ṣiīma ramaḍān, fa-ʾāmannā bimā jāʾa bih.
dialogue.en: He taught us to perform the prayer, give zakat and fast Ramadan, so we believed in what he brought.
dialogue.ur: Us ne humein namaz ada karna, zakat dena aur Ramazan ke roze rakhna sikhaya, to hum us ke laye hue deen par imaan laye.

dialogue.ar: هَلْ تَحْفَظُ شَيْئاً مِمّا أُنْزِلَ عَلَيْهِ؟
dialogue.tr: hal taḥfaẓu shayʾn mimmā unzila ʿalayh?
dialogue.en: Do you remember anything of what was sent down to him?
dialogue.ur: Kya aap ko us par nazil hone wali cheez mein se kuch yaad hai?

dialogue.ar: نَعَمْ أَيُّها المَلِكُ، ثُمَّ قَرَأَ عَلَيْهِ آياتٍ مِنْ سورَةِ مَرْيَم.
dialogue.tr: naʿam ayyuhā l-malik, thumma qaraʾa ʿalayhi ʾāītin min sūrati maryam.
dialogue.en: Yes, O king, and then he recited to him verses from Surat Maryam.
dialogue.ur: Ji haan ae badshah, phir us ne Surah Maryam ki kuch aayaat us ko parh kar sunayin.

dialogue.ar: فَبَكى النَّجاشِيُّ وَبَكَتْ أَساقِفَتُهُ حَتّى بَلَّتْ دُموعُهُمْ لِحاهُمْ وَأَوْراقَهُم.
dialogue.tr: fa-bakā n-najāshiyyu wa bakat asāqifatuhu ḥattā ballat dumūʿuhum li-ḥāhum wa awrāqahum.
dialogue.en: Najashi wept, and his bishops wept until their tears wet their beards and their papers.
dialogue.ur: Najashi roya aur us ke padri bhi roye yahan tak ke un ke aansuon se un ki darhiyan aur kaghaz bheeg gaye.

dialogue.ar: وَاللهِ ما هٰذا وَما جاءَ بِهِ عيسى إِلّا نورٌ مِنْ مِشْكاةٍ واحِدَةٍ. عودا إِلى قَوْمِكُما، فَلَنْ أَرُدَّ هٰؤُلاءِ عَلَيْكُما أَبَداً.
dialogue.tr: wa l-lhi mā hādhā wa mā jāʾa bihi ʿīsā illā nūrun min mishkātin wāḥidat. ʿūdā ilā qawmikumā, fa-lan arudda hāʾulāʾi ʿalaykumā abadn.
dialogue.en: By Allah, this and what Jesus brought are only a light from one lamp-niche. Go back to your people; I will never return these people to you.
dialogue.ur: Allah ki qasam, yeh aur jo Isa laye, ek hi chiragh-daan ka noor hain. Apni qaum ke paas laut jao, main in logon ko tumhare hawale hargiz nahi karunga.

q.en: Where did the Muslims in this story settle?
q.ur: Is kahani mein musalman kahan base?
q.ar: أَيْنَ اسْتَقَرَّ المُسْلِمونَ في هٰذِهِ القِصَّةِ؟

q.en: Who was the king who protected the Muslims?
q.ur: Musalmanon ki hifazat karne wala badshah kaun tha?

q.en: Who spoke to the king about Islam?
q.ur: Badshah se Islam ke baare mein kis ne baat ki?

q.en: What did Quraysh send with their two men?
q.ur: Quraish ne apne do aadmiyon ke saath kya bheja?

q.en: What was the king's reaction when he heard the recitation?
q.ur: Tilawat sun kar badshah ne kya kiya?
q.ar: ماذا فَعَلَ المَلِكُ حينَ سَمِعَ التِّلاوَةَ؟

intro.en: A review test with reading, vocabulary and grammar exercises, followed by the answer slides. Try each exercise first, then check the answers. Remember: a feminine verb for a feminine doer, and the object can come before the doer.
intro.ur: Dohrai ka imtihan jis mein parhna, alfaz aur qawaid ki mashqein hain, phir jawabat ki slides. Pehle khud hal karein phir jawab dekhein. Yaad rakhein: muannas fa'il ke liye muannas fe'l, aur maf'ool fa'il se pehle aa sakta hai.
intro.ar: اخْتِبارُ مُراجَعَةٍ فيهِ تَمارينُ في القِراءَةِ وَالمُفْرَداتِ وَالقَواعِدِ، يَتْبَعُهُ شَرائِحُ الإِجاباتِ. حاوِلْ كُلَّ تَمْرينٍ أَوَّلاً ثُمَّ راجِعِ الإِجابَةَ. تَذَكَّرْ: يُؤَنَّثُ الفِعْلُ لِلْفاعِلِ المُؤَنَّثِ، وَقَدْ يَتَقَدَّمُ المَفْعولُ عَلى الفاعِلِ.

q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَدُلُّ عَلى لَوْنِ الثَّلْجِ؟

options_ar: غَرْسُ النَّباتِ وَالعِنايَةُ بِهِ لِلْحُصولِ عَلى الغِذاءِ

q.en: Which verb form is correct for a female doer?
q.ur: Aurat fa'il ke liye sahi fe'l kaun sa hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ جُمْلَةٍ فيها الفِعْلُ الصَّحيحُ لِفاعِلٍ مُؤَنَّثٍ؟
